verdict.rationale: SerpApi covers the search step well for agents. It returns structured JSON or LLM-optimized markdown output for every API, ships an official MCP server so agents can use it as a web search tool, and pitches RAG pipelines. However, the evidence shows only search-results data. There is nothing showing it extracts the full contents of result pages or synthesizes answers, so the agent would need other tools for the extract and synthesize steps. Missing for 10: page/URL content extraction, built-in synthesis or answer generation, a single-API multi-step research workflow, independent corroboration.
